description: This file contains functions and variables related to HTML entity escaping and unescaping, including handling of character references, comment escaping, and string escaping/unescaping within the 'html' package.

methods.name: unescapeEntity
methods.description: Reads an HTML entity like '<' from a byte slice and writes the corresponding character to the destination, handling numeric and named entities.

methods.name: unescape
methods.description: Unescapes HTML entities in a byte slice in-place, converting entities like '<' to '<'.

methods.name: lower
methods.description: Converts all uppercase ASCII letters in a byte slice to lowercase in-place.

methods.name: escapeComment
methods.description: Escapes special characters in an HTML comment string, particularly '&' and '>' under specific conditions.

methods.name: escapeCommentString
methods.description: Returns an escaped version of a string suitable for HTML comments, minimizing escaping.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes special characters in a string to their HTML entity equivalents, such as '&' to '&'.

methods.name: EscapeString
methods.description: Escapes special characters in a string to HTML entities; only five characters are escaped.

methods.name: UnescapeString
methods.description: Unescapes HTML entities in a string, converting entities like '<' to '<'.
